examples.title: Examples
examples.example1: "泥" is analyzed as the 泥 initial.
examples.example2: "豪" is analyzed as the 豪 rime.
examples.example3: "蟹 + (Select All) Division" analyzes divisions I, II, III, and IV of the 蟹 rime group ("-" means match all; a Middle Chinese category name must follow it).
examples.example4: "次浊 + (Select All) Tone" analyzes secondary-voiced initials with all four tones.
examples.example5: "宕 江" analyzes the characters belonging to the 宕 and 江 rime groups together (a space combines them; pressing Enter treats them as separate features).
examples.example6: "庄组" is analyzed as the 庄 initial group (entering only "庄" uses the 庄 initial).
examples.example7: "流开一" analyzes open Division I characters in the 流 rime group.
examples.example8: "假 + 知组 章组" analyzes characters in the 知 and 章 initial groups within the 假 rime group.
examples.example10: "(Select All) Place" analyzes all places of articulation, including labiodental, glottal, retroflex, palatal, velar, bilabial, and dental.

help.title: Direct Input Guide

rules.rule1: Separate multiple category expressions with spaces. Each expression represents one query combination.
rules.rule2: A value that occurs in only one category, such as "泥" in "母", does not require a suffix.
rules.rule3: A value that occurs in more than one category, such as "山" in both "攝" and "韻", must include a category suffix, for example "山攝" or "山韻".
rules.rule4: A "-" prefix before a category name matches every value in that category. For example, "-等" matches every division, while "蟹-等" matches every division of the 蟹 rime group.
rules.rule5: Multiple criteria can be combined freely. For example, "蟹-等 知組" queries every division of the 蟹 rime group together with the 知 initial group.
rules.rule6: Compound expressions such as "流開一" are parsed into their component criteria.

help.examplesNote: The following examples use the Middle Chinese (Guangyun) character list

examples.title: Examples
examples.example2: "蟹-等" → Use divisions I, II, III, and IV of the 蟹 rime group
examples.example3: "次濁-調" → Use secondary-voiced initials with all four tones
examples.example4: "庄組" → Use the 庄 initial group (entering only "庄" uses the 庄 initial)
examples.example5: "流開一" → Use open Division I characters in the 流 rime group
examples.example7: "-部位" → Use all places of articulation
examples.example8: "山攝 知組" → Combine the 山 rime group with the 知 initial group
